BiblicalUsage: Muaqah is pressure, distress — Thou broughtest us into the net, the psalmist says, Thou laidst affliction upon our loins.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the pressure is named as God's own doing: He brought us into the net, and He brought us out into a wealthy place.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
